quotes.text: … I'm very open to immigration. However, I do not see any benefit in terms of the open border policies, where anybody can come in, or anybody can be settled wherever.
quotes.editor_note: From an August 2024 WPR interview on the WI-4 Republican primary — the only on-record, spoken statement of her immigration position found, and no more recent public statement supersedes it. Position: open to legal immigration, opposed to unrestricted border crossing. Verbatim; the blind version drops her opening 'I am a immigrant myself, so' framing (a self-identifying credibility claim, not load-bearing to the position itself).

quotes.text: Accountability in every dollar. Discipline in every budget. Transparency in every decision. Taxpayers deserve efficiency, not waste, theft and fraud.
quotes.editor_note: From her 2026 campaign site's fiscal-management platform section — the only available statement of her tax/spending philosophy: budget discipline and anti-waste, favoring restraint over higher spending. Verbatim as published. Flagging honestly: it states a direction but no specific tax mechanism, so it's thinner than a policy proposal — this is the best material found, not a manufactured HOW.
